description.en: Creates a light (Low) model of a match player for an in-match scene: CMND_CREATE_CHARA(6, _charaname, "dmmy", _paramID, _is_upper, false, false, _teamID). During a match the player is found in the match data and dressed in their match kit. Unless _no_bustup is true, a bust-up picture named after the object with "ev顔" appended is created too.
Parameter ID of the player (or its hash, e.g. from CMND_BTL_GET_ADD_MEMBER_CRC).
Team to search: 0 = the player's team, 1 = the opponent team, 2 = search by ID only.
true to skip the bust-up picture.
Handle of the new character (see CMND_CREATE_CHARA).

examples.case: The newly added match member (real usage, from ev43030000.nut; the Shift-JIS object name is replaced by a variable here)
examples.code:
local crc = CMND_BTL_GET_ADD_MEMBER_CRC();
local hNakamaL = CreateEvLowMdlForMatch(charaName, isEvUpperDisp, crc);
